themes.zen: Warm Japanese zen mountain retreat in morning sun: sculptural pine, waterfall, misty dramatic peaks, timber terrace, stone garden and a small calm cat on the right. themes.nord: Mythic Scandinavian fjord at northern dawn: one solitary Norse warrior / Viking seen mostly from behind, standing center-right on a snowy black-rock cliff, full body visible, calm disciplined stance, dark layered fur and leather cloak, no battle pose and no weapon emphasis. A large realistic grey wolf stands beside him, also fully visible. Below: deep fjord water with a few distant longships, compact warm-lit Nordic settlement / citadel across the water, immense snow mountains and mist. Palette: dark navy, steel blue, icy cyan and white with restrained green aurora; warm amber only in windows, fires and reflections. Add one ancient dark rune monolith near far-right edge with subtle cold cyan rune glow. Keep upper-left and lower-left quieter for financial UI. Premium cinematic editorial realism, calm strength, discipline and long-horizon feeling; distinctive, not generic fantasy.
themes.imperium: Sunlit monumental contemporary-classical financial city: warm ivory stone, brushed gold details, soaring arches and modern skyline, a restrained white stone lion sculpture center-right, water reflections and long morning shadows. Luxurious but tasteful, no fantasy palace excess. Quiet warm left third for data.
